Class InventoryDao

java.lang.Object
sakaboba.dao.InventoryDao
public class InventoryDao extends Object
Ingredient inventory persistence. Each operation opens and closes its own connection.

  • Method Details

    • findAll

      public List<Ingredient> findAll()
      Loads every ingredient, ordered by name.
      Returns:
      all ingredients with their stock on hand
      Throws:
      DataAccessException - if the database cannot be read

    • insert

      public Ingredient insert(String name, BigDecimal quantity, String unit)
      Adds an ingredient after validating its fields, assigning the next free ID in one transaction.
      Parameters:
      name - ingredient name, required, at most 100 characters
      quantity - stock on hand, 0 or more; rounded to 2 decimals
      unit - one of UNITS
      Returns:
      the saved ingredient including its new ID
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if a field is invalid
      DataAccessException - if the database write fails

    • update

      public void update(int id, String name, BigDecimal quantity, String unit)
      Changes an existing ingredient's name, quantity and unit.
      Parameters:
      id - ID of the ingredient to change
      name - new name, required, at most 100 characters
      quantity - new stock on hand, 0 or more; rounded to 2 decimals
      unit - one of UNITS
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the ID or a field is invalid
      DataAccessException - if the ingredient no longer exists or the write fails

    • validate

      static Ingredient validate(String name, BigDecimal quantity, String unit)
      Checks a new ingredient's name, quantity and unit.
      Parameters:
      name - raw name from the form
      quantity - raw quantity from the form
      unit - raw unit from the form
      Returns:
      the cleaned ingredient, with ID 0 until it is inserted
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if a field is invalid

    • insertRow

      static Ingredient insertRow(Connection connection, Ingredient clean) throws SQLException
      Inserts an already validated ingredient inside the caller's transaction, which must hold the ingredient table lock.
      Parameters:
      connection - open connection inside the caller's transaction
      clean - ingredient returned by validate(java.lang.String, java.math.BigDecimal, java.lang.String)
      Returns:
      the ingredient with its newly assigned ID
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the insert fails

    • validateName

      private static String validateName(String value)
      Trims and checks an ingredient name.
      Parameters:
      value - raw name from the form
      Returns:
      the trimmed name
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if it is blank or too long

    • validateQuantity

      private static BigDecimal validateQuantity(BigDecimal value)
      Checks a quantity against the DECIMAL(10,2) column: non-negative with at most 8 digits before the decimal point.
      Parameters:
      value - raw quantity from the form
      Returns:
      the quantity rounded to 2 decimals
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if it is missing, negative or too large

    • validateUnit

      private static String validateUnit(String value)
      Checks that a unit is one of UNITS.
      Parameters:
      value - raw unit from the form
      Returns:
      the trimmed unit
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the unit is not allowed
